units.source_text: 我为什么变得如此大胆？

en.t: Why had I become so bold?

units.source_text: 它与我实行这项计划后反常地变得格外快活，并为不可名状的喜悦所振奋的这种难以想像，

en.t: This impossibility of imagining it matched the equally unimaginable way that, after carrying out this plan, I had become strangely and extraordinarily cheerful, stirred by an indescribable joy,
as though the two answered each other.

units.source_text: 初始我本想趁老师不在悄悄地干，而不让他察觉出是谁干的。

en.t: At first I had meant to do it quietly while the teacher was away, without letting him realize who had done it.

units.source_text: 可是，这时候，一股昂扬的情绪驱使着我选择了让他清楚地知道是我干的危险的办法。

en.t: But at that moment, an exultant emotion drove me to choose the dangerous course of making him clearly know that I was the one who had done it.
